name: shaft_with_revolved_collar
description: A cylindrical shaft made by revolve with a raised revolved collar around the same axis.
source_license: Project-authored example; not from an external dataset.
derived_by: Hand-authored from validated Prompt2ParametricCAD eval JSON.
construction_plan: Create the shaft as a base revolve around a vertical axis in the XY plane.
Represent the shaft radius with a rectangle offset from the axis.
Add the collar with add_revolve around the same axis.
Place the collar profile so it overlaps the shaft radius and protrudes outward.
notes: Revolved additions do not use target faces.
For a collar, reuse the shaft axis and make the new revolved solid overlap the existing shaft.
